name: Vásárosbéc (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vásárosbéc (a shield divided diagonally green and blue with a tree and three white stars) below the name VÁSÁROSBÉC in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
